evidence: Tasks sorted by Priority show High-priority tasks (Review project proposal, Complete tax filing, Submit final report) before Medium (Schedule dentist appointment) and Low (Buy groceries) priority tasks.

After sorting by Deadline, tasks appear in order: Buy groceries (Tomorrow), Review project proposal (Aug 27), Submit final report (Aug 30), Schedule dentist appointment (Sep 1), Complete tax filing (Sep 8). Earliest deadlines are first, with tasks ordered chronologically.
Created task "Test Task Simple" with only title. Task appears in active list, active count increased from 5 to 6, and creation notification displayed.

Created task "Task with All Fields" with title, description "This task has all fields filled in", deadline "Aug 28", priority "High", and two prerequisites "Test Task Simple" and "Review project proposal". Task appears in list with all details retained, showing "2 prerequisites incomplete" indicator.
Marked "Buy groceries" as completed. Task left active view and active count decreased from 7 to 6. Completed count increased from 2 to 3. Task no longer visible in active list.

Clicked Completed button and view switched to show only completed tasks: Buy groceries, Reply to client emails, Organize desk. Completed button is now highlighted (active). Count shows "3 completed". Switching back to active view would show active tasks only.

Updated "Schedule dentist appointment" task - changed title to "Schedule dentist - Updated", description, and priority to High. Changes were saved and retained in task list. Deleted "Test Task Simple" task - it was removed from active list, active count decreased to 4, and deletion notification displayed.
Attempted to create task with empty title and with whitespace-only title. Create Task button remained disabled in both cases, preventing task creation. Task list unchanged.

Set up scenario where Task A (Task with All Fields) depends on Task B (Submit final report). When attempting to edit Task B and select available prerequisites, Task A was not available as an option, preventing circular dependency. System successfully prevents direct/indirect cycles.

Assigned one or more prerequisites to "Task with All Fields" during creation and modification. Task displays and retains assigned prerequisites: initially "Review project proposal" and test task, later updated to add "Submit final report". Task shows blocking status based on prerequisites.

Blocked task "Task with All Fields" is visibly distinguished - complete button is disabled [disabled], distinguishing it from unblocked tasks. Blocking prevents completion action until prerequisites are satisfied.

Blocked task "Task with All Fields" displays prominent warning "Prerequisite 'Submit final report' incomplete" naming the specific incomplete prerequisite. Warning is clearly visible next to task title.
Blocked task "Task with All Fields" has disabled complete button preventing completion while prerequisite "Submit final report" is incomplete. Button state visually indicates it cannot be clicked.

Each task displays title, priority, description (when provided), deadline (when provided), and prerequisite state. Completed tasks are visibly distinguished by appearance in Completed tab, uncomplete button, and separate view from Active tasks. Active and completed states are clearly differentiated.

Completed tasks remain available in completed view after switching between Active and Completed views. "Buy groceries", "Reply to client emails", "Review project proposal", "Complete tax filing", and "Organize desk" all persist in Completed view until explicitly deleted.

issue: Blocked task edit functionality not available
actual: Edit button for blocked task "Task with All Fields" is disabled and non-functional. No alternative interface found to edit description and priority fields. Complete button is also disabled.
evidence: Attempted to click edit button for blocked task - no action occurred. Description text click also did not open edit interface. Requirement states blocked tasks should allow modification of description and priority fields.

Hovering over "Prerequisite 'Submit final report' incomplete" warning displays tooltip with "Dependency Chain" showing three tasks: Review project proposal (completed), Submit final report (marked pending), Complete tax filing (completed). Chain clearly identifies pending prerequisite tasks.

issue: Completed dependent tasks left in invalid state after prerequisite reopening
actual: When "Review project proposal" prerequisite was reopened, dependent tasks "Submit final report" and "Complete tax filing" were left simultaneously completed (in Completed view) AND blocked (showing prerequisite incomplete warning with disabled uncomplete buttons). System neither prevented reopening nor moved dependents to incomplete state.
evidence: Before: "Submit final report" completed with "2 prerequisites completed". After reopening prerequisite: "Submit final report" in Completed view but showing "Prerequisite 'Review project proposal' incomplete" with disabled uncomplete button. Invalid state: completed but blocked.

issue: Connection line hover tooltip not implemented
actual: SVG connection lines exist between dependent tasks but hovering over them does not display dependency chain tooltip. Attempted mouseenter event on SVG lines but no tooltip appeared.
evidence: Browser evaluation found SVG line/path elements but mouseenter event did not trigger tooltip. Requirement requires hovering over visual connections to display dependency chain information.
